sections.label: Questions 27-30
sections.instruction: Complete the flow-chart. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
sections.html:
Advice on exam preparation

  1. Make sure you know the exam requirements.
  2. Find some past papers.
  3. Work out your {{Q27}} for revision and write them on a card.
  4. Make a {{Q28}} and keep it in view.
  5. Divide revision into {{Q29}} for each day.
  6. Write one {{Q30}} about each topic.
  7. Practise writing some exam answers.
